title: Video scanner
summary: Scan a screen recording of your inventory instead of taking screenshots one by one.

changes.text: Video tab in the scanner: drop a screen recording of your inventory (MP4, WebM or MOV) and every material in it is recognised on your device, or try the sample recording.
The scanner picks the frames where scrolling settles, checks that consecutive frames overlap so no row is skipped, and reads each quantity in several frames to outvote a blurry one.
While a recording is scanned you see a timeline of the frames picked and the cards found in the latest one.
